title: Assalam Boys Secondary School student protest over poor diet
reason: Not a qualifying own-state/public-policy demand. The opened account locates student mobilization at a school over complaints to school management about poor diet and property damage; it does not report a demand to the Malawi state or policy-maker. No turnout evidence is supplied.
notes: Body states hunger strike on Jan 21 and students stoned school buildings around 1 am on Jan 23. Not conflated with a public policy demonstration.

title: CSTU/TUM planned nationwide civil servants strike beginning January 9
reason: Pre-announced nationwide strike was explicitly called off before its scheduled January 9 start after Jan 6 negotiations; no actual January gathering/work stoppage is reported. An announcement or workforce size alone is not a public protest event.
notes: S008 is opened contemporaneous report; S011 is post-period search-only retrospective corroboration; S012 is pre-period announcement. This is not coded as zero attendees; it is excluded for nonoccurrence of the announced action.
